chunks: The Shaykh, the jurist, Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Sa'd ibn Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Hammad al-Baghdadi narrated to us, from Bishr ibn Ghiyath al-Marisi. He said: Abu Yusuf Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim narrated to me, from Abu Hanifa, from Abd al-Rahman al-Salmani, from Hanash ibn al-Mu'tamir, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him). He said:

The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) called me and directed me to Yemen to make peace between them. I said: O Messenger of God, they are a numerous people and they are of age, while I am a young man. He said: O Ali, when you reach the top of the pass of Afiq, call out with your loudest voice: O trees, O clods, O soil -- Muhammad the Messenger of God sends you greetings of peace. So I went, and when I reached the top of the pass, I overlooked the people of Yemen, and behold, all of them were advancing towards me with spears raised, spearheads leveled, bows slung, and weapons drawn. So I called out with my loudest voice: O trees, O clods, O soil -- Muhammad the Messenger of God sends you greetings of peace. And not a tree, a clod, nor any soil remained but it trembled with one voice: And upon Muhammad the Messenger of God and upon you, peace! Then the legs of the people shook, their knees trembled, the weapons fell from their hands, and they came to me hastening. So I made peace between them and returned.

key_terms.ارتجّ بصوت واحد: Irtajja bi-sawtin wahid - trembled with one voice, describing the unified miraculous response of nature
key_terms.عقبة أفيق: Aqabat Afiq - the mountain pass of Afiq, a well-known passage on the route to Yemen
key_terms.يقرئكم السلام: Yuqri'ukum al-salam - sends you greetings of peace, a formal sending of salutation

ai.seo_question: What miracle happened when Imam Ali was sent to Yemen?
ai.summary: Imam Ali recounts being sent by the Prophet to Yemen as a young man to reconcile warring factions. Despite his concern about his youth, the Prophet instructed him to call upon the trees, clods, and soil in the name of Muhammad. When Ali did so at the pass of Afiq, the entire natural world responded with a unified salaam, causing the armed Yemeni warriors to drop their weapons in awe and submit to peace. This miracle, narrated through Sunni chains (Abu Hanifa, Abu Yusuf), demonstrates the cosmic authority granted to Ali and the obedience of creation to the Prophet's command.
